sources.title: olegGerbylev/Qwen2-0.5B-from-scratch · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen2-.5B-Instruct Introduction Qwen2 is the new series of Qwen large language models. For Qwen2, we release a number of base language models and instruction-tuned language models ranging from 0.5 to 72 billion parameters, including a Mixture-of-Experts model. sources.title: Qwen2 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: The model series encompasses foundational, i.e., base language models, pre-trained but unaligned to human preferences, and instruction-tuned models, fine-tuned with single-turn and multi-turn instruction-following datasets suitable for chat and agent purposes.
